shared_decision_rules.basis: CIS defines substantive practice; the application outcome labels are the user-authorized contract, not CIS certification or CAS percentages.
precedence: Ignore inactive retained answers and optional context for factual status.
No meaningful accepted substantive basis/all unknown:Not Assessed.
Affirmative absence of all applicable substantive practice:Not Implemented.
Meaningful accepted implementation plus any material absent/partial/unresolved requirement:Partially Implemented.
All applicable substantive requirements accepted, with no reported material gap/uncertainty:Implemented.
A conditional exclusion needs the specific source condition and rationale. Whole-record Not Applicable stays on the existing authorized native approval path; the interview never grants it.
shared_decision_rules.contradiction: For new active atomic questions, contradictory aggregate practice answers cannot erase substantive answers or produce unqualified Implemented. Treat meaningful atomic implementation plus unresolved contradiction as partial; if no meaningful basis,Not Assessed. Legacy root-gated retained answers stay inactive and are ignored.
shared_decision_rules.narrative: Editing prose alone preserves factual answers/status; explicit reviewed assessment submission preserves exact text and separately writes status.
